prs.body: Switches the default behavior of Consensus to use `roundCloseTime` instead of `effCloseTime`. `effCloseTime` is still used when accepting the consensus ledger to ensure the consensus close time comes after the parent ledger close time. This change eliminates an edge case in which peers could reach agreement on the close time, but end up generating ledgers with different close times.
prs.head: bachase:roundclose
